evidence: CURRENT_STATE.md, DEMO_RELEASE_PLAN.yaml, MODULE_MAP.md и IMPLEMENTATION_SEQUENCE.md содержат несогласованные статусы принятых PERSONNEL-AUTHORITY/OPJ и очереди SHIFT
impact: Запуск неверного work item; потеря решений; повторное проектирование
recommended_treatment: Сверить release owner с accepted history и ввести автоматическую производность human-readable views
acceptance_criteria: Все canonical views согласованы; checker падает при расхождении; user acceptance

evidence: PR #49 branch создан от c57a847 и на factual preflight diverged от main 8bd895 на 3 documentation commits
impact: Аудит или merge могут опираться на устаревшую документационную историю
recommended_treatment: Перед финальным merge синхронизировать main обычным merge commit или доказать отсутствие content conflict; запретить stale-base final gate
acceptance_criteria: PR merge base актуален; changed files conflict-free; exact-head workflows green

evidence: settings.py допускает только development/ci/preview; production или pilot mode отсутствует
impact: Нельзя fail-closed проверить промышленную конфигурацию; Preview ошибочно становится суррогатом production
recommended_treatment: Создать отдельный pilot/production configuration contract и mode без изменения demo semantics
acceptance_criteria: Production check проходит только с TLS/proxy/cookie/DB/secrets controls; unsafe config refuses start

evidence: Все Django apps и URL namespaces подключены глобально; универсальный module registry/manifest/scoped activation отсутствует
impact: Невозможно безопасно поставлять разные наборы модулей по объектам; feature leakage; ручные guards
recommended_treatment: Спроектировать control plane и затем реализовать manifest, dependencies, scoped activation и lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Два tenant/site/workplace набора активируются независимо; disable blocks writes and preserves history

evidence: В MIDDLEWARE обнаружен специализированный EquipmentDefectRouteGuardMiddleware, но нет общего route/service/task/API guard
impact: Активация может контролировать UI, но не все write paths; обход через service/admin/command
recommended_treatment: Ввести единый capability predicate на route, service, command, export и admin boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Negative tests доказывают DENY для всех entry points; no hidden route after disable

evidence: Dependency direction описан в SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE, но не проверяется автоматическим import rule; operational_documents напрямую связывает несколько core apps
impact: Рост cyclic coupling и god modules; дорогие изменения и сложная передача сопровождения
recommended_treatment: Добавить manifest/import-lint и публичные service contracts между modules
acceptance_criteria: CI блокирует запрещённые imports; dependency graph опубликован и cycle-free

evidence: Ruff содержит точечные ignores для крупных personnel management files; нет hotspot budget/ownership
impact: Накопление исключений и сложность безопасного изменения
recommended_treatment: Создать maintainability inventory и ограничить рост complexity/ignore debt
acceptance_criteria: Hotspots имеют owners/plan; new ignores require explicit decision; complexity trend не ухудшается

evidence: Direction A coexistence допускает legacy/partial layers; OPJ acceptance потребовала неоднократных asset/CSS repairs
impact: Overlay accumulation, stale CSS flash, browser-specific regressions
recommended_treatment: Ввести route-to-template/static inventory и strangler migration with delete evidence
acceptance_criteria: Для каждого migrated route известны active assets; obsolete layers removed only after tests; Edge/Chrome evidence

evidence: Playwright только optional dependency; exact-head workflows не выполняют blocking browser/visual suite
impact: Green CI не ловит сломанные действия, stale assets, print/theme/browser defects
recommended_treatment: Создать blocking critical-route browser suite и controlled screenshot baselines
acceptance_criteria: Critical routes pass Edge-compatible Chromium, Chrome, themes, print and responsive gates

evidence: COMPONENT_CATALOG.md документирует primitives, но нет executable component gallery/state tests
impact: Компоненты дрейфуют; новые modules создают локальные варианты
recommended_treatment: Создать versioned component examples и page profile templates
acceptance_criteria: Shared primitives have canonical markup/CSS/JS examples, states and contract tests

evidence: Models запрещают update/delete и фиксируют SHA-256 snapshots, но guards находятся преимущественно в application/model layer
impact: Privileged SQL или ошибочный maintenance script может изменить зарегистрированные факты
recommended_treatment: Least-privilege DB roles, controlled maintenance, periodic integrity scan and break-glass evidence
acceptance_criteria: App role cannot mutate protected history outside approved procedures; integrity report verifies all digests

evidence: Нет подтверждённого scheduled digest/audit consistency scan
impact: Тихое повреждение данных может быть обнаружено поздно или не обнаружено
recommended_treatment: Добавить read-only integrity command, scheduled run and signed report retention
acceptance_criteria: Injected corruption detected; clean baseline report stored with checksum and timestamp

evidence: CI применяет migrations на clean PostgreSQL 18, но не обновляет representative accepted DB snapshots через релизы
impact: Upgrade может пройти на пустой БД и упасть на реальных legacy/data combinations
recommended_treatment: Создать migration compatibility matrix и upgrade fixtures from accepted backups
acceptance_criteria: N-2/N-1 representative snapshots upgrade; object counts and invariants preserved

evidence: Нет доказательства тестирования migrations при разных наборах inactive/active modules
impact: Upgrade одного продукта может повредить или неожиданно активировать данные отключённого module
recommended_treatment: Добавить module-set migration scenarios after registry contract
acceptance_criteria: Inactive modules migrate safely, remain inactive, preserve data and reactivate successfully

evidence: Runbook существует, но repository evidence не содержит периодического restore certificate; retention policy прямо не утверждена
impact: Backup может оказаться невосстановимым; неизвестны RPO/RTO
recommended_treatment: Провести контрольный restore, определить off-host copies, encryption, retention, RPO/RTO and schedule
acceptance_criteria: Successful restore certificate: checksum, duration, counts, integrity, RPO/RTO and owner

evidence: Rollback manual; images rebuild from source/ranged dependencies; no immutable release artifact/schema compatibility map
impact: Повторная сборка может отличаться; rollback code incompatible with DB
recommended_treatment: Build immutable tagged/digest image, publish manifest/SBOM, rehearse code+DB rollback decision tree
acceptance_criteria: Accepted release has image digest, DB compatibility, rollback rehearsal and measured recovery

evidence: pyproject uses version ranges; lock/constraints and image digests not found
impact: Non-reproducible builds and uncontrolled vulnerable updates
recommended_treatment: Introduce reviewed lock/constraints, update cadence, hashes and base image digests
acceptance_criteria: Same commit resolves identical dependencies; automated update PRs and vulnerability policy

evidence: Health endpoint checks only SELECT 1; no readiness/liveness split or module/storage/migration checks
impact: Service can report ok while critical capability is unusable
recommended_treatment: Define liveness/readiness/dependency health and deployment gates
acceptance_criteria: Readiness fails on DB/migration/storage/module critical dependency; liveness remains minimal

evidence: No repository evidence of structured logging, correlation IDs, metrics, dashboards, alert rules or retention
impact: Incidents detected late; diagnosis depends on manual logs and author knowledge
recommended_treatment: Implement structured logs, request/audit correlation, metrics, alerts, dashboards and retention
acceptance_criteria: Scripted failures trigger alerts and can be traced end-to-end within accepted MTTD/MTTR targets

evidence: Incident runbook lacks severity matrix, ownership/escalation, notification times and postmortem SLA
impact: Unclear decisions during outage; recovery delays and repeated incidents
recommended_treatment: Add operational incident model, contacts/roles, severity/SLA and exercise
acceptance_criteria: Tabletop and technical drill completed; roles/timelines/postmortem evidence recorded

evidence: Demo usernames/passwords are emitted in public CI logs
impact: Credential reuse/social engineering risk; unsafe pattern may leak into pilot
recommended_treatment: Remove passwords from logs, rotate demo values, generate ephemeral credentials or mask secrets
acceptance_criteria: Search history/logs contains no active secrets; demo credentials are generated/rotated and not reusable

evidence: No production mode; secure cookies, HSTS and proxy SSL contract absent from settings
impact: Session theft/downgrade risk if deployed beyond isolated loopback Preview
recommended_treatment: Add production fail-closed security settings and deployment checks
acceptance_criteria: Django deploy check and external TLS/session tests pass; HTTP downgrade rejected

evidence: No evidence of secret scan, SAST, dependency/container scan, SBOM or image signing in required workflows
impact: Known vulnerabilities and committed secrets may reach release
recommended_treatment: Add security pipeline with severity policy and signed provenance
acceptance_criteria: Blocking scans pass; exceptions time-bound; SBOM and image attestations retained

evidence: Domain authorities are strong, but MFA, privileged session policy, rate limiting, access review and break-glass governance are not proven
impact: Account compromise enables legally/operationally significant actions
recommended_treatment: Define identity assurance levels, privileged re-auth/MFA, lockout/rate limit, periodic access review
acceptance_criteria: Privileged actions require accepted assurance; stale access revoked; tests cover role/scope/session boundaries

evidence: Controlled imports exist, but complete FileField/upload/download inventory and MIME/size/AV/quarantine controls not evidenced
impact: Malware, oversized files, path/content-type abuse or data exposure
recommended_treatment: Inventory all upload surfaces and implement centralized upload policy
acceptance_criteria: All upload endpoints enforce size/type/quarantine/storage/access; malicious fixtures rejected

evidence: Personnel and operational data exist; no complete retention/deletion/archive/legal-hold matrix verified
impact: Excess retention, unlawful deletion или inability to answer audits
recommended_treatment: Create data classification and retention matrix per entity/evidence type
acceptance_criteria: Approved retention owner/rules; archive and legal-hold tests; no physical delete of protected facts

evidence: SOURCE_REGISTRY exists, but no machine-readable module→mandatory documents/instructions/freshness matrix
impact: Work item starts without required local/normative evidence; decisions drift
recommended_treatment: Create MODULE_SOURCE_REQUIREMENTS matrix and preflight gate
acceptance_criteria: Every active module/capability resolves required source IDs and freshness; missing source blocks start

evidence: Drive role accepted conceptually, but library structure, ownership, checksums and stale-link process are not canonicalized
impact: Lost originals, ambiguous versions, Drive competing with GitHub decisions
recommended_treatment: Define Drive library taxonomy and GitHub metadata/checksum/link contract
acceptance_criteria: Sample source can be located, checksum-verified and traced to GitHub decision without duplicate owner

evidence: Runbooks extensive, but independent clean install/restore/upgrade by another specialist not evidenced
impact: Bus factor remains high; owner becomes operational bottleneck
recommended_treatment: Run independent handover exercise and publish service catalog/support matrix
acceptance_criteria: Second specialist performs install, restore, upgrade, rollback and diagnosis without oral instructions

evidence: No single accepted pilot gate combining product, security, DR, operations, UX and support evidence
impact: Demo may be mislabeled pilot-ready; unsafe deployment decision
recommended_treatment: Create PILOT_READINESS contract and independent acceptance
acceptance_criteria: All critical risks closed/accepted; pilot checklist evidence and owner approval; limitations explicit

evidence: Concurrency tests exist, but no accepted workload model, latency/SLO, capacity or soak test evidence
impact: Pilot degradation under real record volume/concurrent users
recommended_treatment: Define representative workload and execute load/soak/DB growth tests
acceptance_criteria: P95 targets, concurrency, DB size growth and resource headroom accepted

evidence: No complete export package for records, snapshots, audit, source IDs and future attachments proven
impact: Vendor/maintainer lock-in; difficult disaster migration or regulatory response
recommended_treatment: Define canonical export and restore/import verification
acceptance_criteria: Export is schema-versioned, checksumed, human/machine readable and round-trip verified

evidence: Django admin is globally routed at /admin/; production authorization, audit and network restrictions not evidenced
impact: Privileged bypass of product workflows and module guards
recommended_treatment: Inventory admin actions; disable or harden production admin; audit every privileged mutation
acceptance_criteria: No protected fact can be mutated/deleted through admin; admin access restricted and audited

evidence: New domain queue is paused, but no accepted split between safe-continuation prerequisites and pilot-only hardening
impact: Either unsafe feature rush or endless platform rewrite
recommended_treatment: Adopt two gates SAFE-CONTINUATION and PILOT-READY with explicit work-item ordering
acceptance_criteria: Owner accepts gates; roadmap links every work item to risks and acceptance evidence
